name: Elected Admin 🗳️
desc:
🗳️ VOTE or get voted
💪 Player with most votes gets ADMIN
🔨 BUILD anything, or DESTROY everything...

🗳️ Elected Admin is a building sandbox admin experience all about freedom! Play as a player and build anything you can imagine, or win the election to become the chosen one, the admin, and use admin powers over the players! The possibilities are endless, ranging from peaceful town worlds to ruined wastelands.

🛠️ Builds save in free private servers!
